tier_should.rationale: Innovative juxtaposition of epidemiological modeling with reduced-form economics; credible data, rigorous checks, relevant findings for vaccine valuation; suitable for top health-econ or AEJ outlet.

tier_will.rationale: Methodologically strong but incremental relative to existing measles studies; limited generality, NBER draft status; likely placement in solid field journal (J Health Econ, JDE), not top-five general.
